einzeiler: Highlights from the final season of Talk With Flea featuring guest interviews and rants.
kurzfassung: The hosts review standout moments from their debut season, revisiting memorable guest appearances and heated discussions. They look back at notable interviews with figures like Kevin Hart, Max B, and Dana White. The episode wraps up with humorous banter and highlights from various co-hosts and comedians.
stichpunkte: Looking back at the most eventful moments and fan favorites of the podcast's first season
Recalling the tense and humorous ten-second interview with Kevin Hart
Discussing J. Cole rescheduling and the background behind the missed interview dates
Celebrating Max B's release from prison and his rapid post-release success
Highlighting the intense interview with UFC head Dana White about the Muhammad Ali Act
Revisiting memorable drop-ins and discussions with guests like Anderson Paak and Gilly
Debating relationship dynamics and financial expectations with guest analysts like Arabia
Reflecting on the origins of the early internet porn venture Dip Sex

beschreibung:
We're wrapping up season one and going back through all the heat. Kevin Hart almost walked out on us, J. Cole finally explained why he kept postponing the interview, and we talked to Max B just three days after he came home from doing 18 years. We also had Dana White talking about boxing, Shyne on politics, and Chopper City keeping it real about the Puff documentary. Plus wild conversations with Corey Holcomb, Gillie, Anderson Pack, and way more. Thanks to everybody who watched this season.. Season two is coming soon.
